about: THE VILLAGE BATTERY — labeled requests for the expert faces (docs/SOP/PRUNING.md, SOP-14). The first winning-ticket measurement (2026-10-31, 94,147 texts) found 180 of 308 scope words dead — not because they are noise, but because the exercise corpora were claims (the gates) and search-bar words (traffic); nobody had asked the village its own questions in the window. A gap in the test set is not a reason to prune, so the village's questions are tracked here: the routing block of tests/test_faces.py, its compose cases, and the Conductor's many-sided panel queries (scratch benchmark, 2026-10-31). `text` is the exercise; `faces` is the label — the faces a wise Conductor should seat — so a word that fires on a request meant for ANOTHER face can be measured as a false route (the precision criterion, the next unit of SOP-14). Add a row whenever a real request is mis-routed in the wild; never delete one.
